title: [Docs] Get started Locally still points to CUDA-12.9
bug_description: ### 🐛 Describe the bug Go to https://pytorch.org/get-started/locally/ select, Linux, Nightly and `CUDA-12.9` option is still available there, even though 12.9 builds has been removed by https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/161916 Also `Latest PyTorch requires Python 3.9 or later` is also misleading, as nightlies for 3.9 are not available since https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/161427 ### Versions Web cc @ezyang @gchanan @zou3519 @kadeng @msaroufim @seemethere @atalman @svekars @sekyondaMeta @AlannaBurke
